Grace is reading a book about science. Grace wrote about the day in the diary. Grace is going to travel to Paris in November. She studies every evening.

The weather was cloudy that day. The school garden is one of the best places in the city. There are always many people at the reading room. For example, lucy will represent our school in the English contest.
Grace learned a lot about science. Life is full of small surprises. Grace hopes to visit Paris one day. The home team finished the whole season undefeated.
It takes twenty minutes to get to the school garden by bike. Grace plays badminton with Owen every Saturday. Both of them like salad and tea.
